environment: Local macOS arm64, installed Google Chrome in headless mode via Playwright
method: Real MediaPipe model and local WASM, VIDEO mode, numHands=2, 640x480 canvas.captureStream(30), small animated horizontal translation; no webcam or glove hardware
network: All requests outside the local Vite origin blocked; zero attempted external requests during inference

cpu_fallback_two_hand_sample.trigger: Browser-injected rejection of GPU delegate initialization; actual CPU model and WASM used successfully

visual_qa: GPU overlay inspected in light and dark themes at 1440x900; 21 landmarks, outlined white bones, state dots, guide, confidence badge and missing calibration gaps verified
limitations: Shared development host under parallel worker load; headless Chrome and a repeated image do not establish target-laptop webcam performance or physical camera-to-display latency. The 25ms p95 inference target remains unmet and must be retested/optimized on the target laptop. CPU delegates still require the browser graphics context for MediaPipe image processing; the fallback test simulates unavailable GPU delegation, not removal of WebGL itself.
